notes.title: 4 Hour Closed Playtest
notes.notes:
Join other players in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/hallsofgreed]Discord[/url]. If you don't have a key from a prior closed playtest, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2814230/Halls_of_Greed/]please request access through the Steam page[/url] prior to 4pm Pacific.

Our goal for this session is to get feedback on the new content we’ve added, and test some new backend systems in development against higher concurrent player counts.

For this playtest:
[list]
[*] All spells are unlocked, and class mastery is disabled
[*] Level Cap reduced from 5 > 3
[*] Merchant is set to level 3 by default
[*] Ruined Castle (Night) Map disabled
[/list]

We want all players to have access to and experiment with all content that is available. Future playtests will reintroduce map selection and unlockable progression.

notes.title: Closed Pre-Alpha Playtest is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Our next playtest starts June 7, 2024 9:00 AM. If you have a Steam key from a previous playtest, that will once again work for this playtest. We have some awesome features to show off, including a Hard mode that will give you more loot as well as a new and improved leaderboard for you to climb! The dev team will be playing a lot during this playtest, and we hope to see you in the Halls!

It would mean the world to us if you could  🌠 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2814230/Halls_of_Greed/]wishlist Halls of Greed[/url] on Steam, as it will help with discoverability causing Steam to show Halls of Greed to more players around the world.
